records.publisher: Binance Support — Security Incident | Recovery Update #4: Withdrawals Resume in Phases
claims: Binance announced phase one of withdrawal restoration for 2026-11-01 between 06:00 and 09:00 UTC.
The phase-one network/asset table explicitly includes the XRP network and XRP.
Binance reports approximately 95% of the impacted amount covered, up from approximately 90% in its previous update.
Binance states BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC balances are fully backed 100%.
Binance says the remaining 5% consists of less-liquid assets outside the named top ten.
Binance says it continues purchasing remaining affected assets through market and OTC channels.
Binance says deposits remain open and it will absorb the financial impact rather than pass losses to users.
Binance says phase-one assets will become available progressively and users should check the network-status page.
limitations: The 95% aggregate replenishment and 100% top-ten coverage are company-reported claims, not independent proof of asset-by-asset purchases or liabilities.
The announcement does not disclose an XRP-specific replenishment quantity, purchase venue, acquisition price, SAFU allocation or corporate-treasury allocation.
The 06:00–09:00 UTC interval is a phase-one rollout window; availability is progressive and may be delayed. It is not proof that every XRP withdrawal was enabled at 06:00.
The public network-status page returned an empty server-rendered table at 05:11 UTC; the XRP-specific live state could not be read from that page.
The full cryptographic Proof of Reserves remains pending the previously announced November 3 target.
No actual customer XRP withdrawal, external destination, sale or market impact is established by this announcement.

records.publisher: Reuters — Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering bulk of $6 billion in stolen funds
claims: Reuters reports Binance's 95% aggregate replenishment statement.
Reuters reports that phase one was scheduled between 06:00 and 09:00 GMT and includes XRP among the assets.
Reuters reports the FBI attribution of the overall Binance theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit.
limitations: Reuters reports Binance's statements and is not an independent asset-by-asset reserve audit.
The report does not disclose XRP-specific acquisitions, purchases, customer withdrawals or on-chain reserve changes.
The FBI attribution applies to the overall incident; it does not independently identify the XRPL attacker receiver as a North Korean-controlled account.

records.publisher: GitHub API and GitHub Actions — Barrot-Agent/B-Agent main, pull requests and workflow evidence
claims: The main branch was observed at cf3ff49e4128c732fe84ca36efb7f0424774e904.
PR #1442 is open, draft, unmerged and based on that exact main SHA; its head is bc84abfeefee3ca60f43fa729d5631ad84719c55.
PR #1442 exact-head CI run 41275266085 completed successfully with 349 tests and 8 subtests passing.
PR #1442 fail-closed gate run 41275266092 completed successfully and kept merging disabled.
Main Cross Analysis run 41274697648 reported zero recent and prior XRP/BTC sentiment-shift samples, then committed a generated_at-only change to sentiment_shift.json.
Main Scheduler Tick run 41276373377 fired zero queue entries; the queue contained one already-completed entry and the final git push reported Everything up-to-date.
The main Cross Analysis, Scheduler Tick and Merge Queue workflows remain write/dispatch-capable until an approved remediation is merged.
The open-pull-request API inventory returned 200 open PRs: 191 drafts, 9 ready, 195 main-based, 194 stale main-based, 1 current-main-based (#1442), and 5 non-main-based.
limitations: The full branch-protection details endpoint returned 403 to the available GitHub integration; only the branch's protected flag is observable, and required-check configuration remains unknown.
Full repository CI has not been run.
A complete lockfile-based dependency vulnerability scan has not been run; security-alert access remains unavailable.
PR #1442 is a proposal. Its successful CI does not change main; no merge or main-branch remediation occurred.
